# Inbox Capture and Promotion

## Borrow from old vault
The old vault used an inbox-first write protocol and later classification/promotion.

## EMA version
New fragments should be allowed to land in an inbox/capture layer, then be:
1. classified
2. linked
3. promoted into durable object pages or track docs
4. harvested into chronicle/review/memory if warranted

## Why
This keeps the graph from requiring perfect placement at the moment of capture.
